texts.facts: 2. Petitioner is the 2nd accused in S.T.No.1030/2016 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court - II, Kothamangalam. The above case is registered alleging offences punishable under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. From those 8 packets, two packets each, were tied together, and four sample units were prepared by the 1st respondent and from such sample units, one sample unit was sent for chemical analysis to the Regional Analytical Laboratory, Ernakulam and a report was received and based on the same, Annexure-I complaint was filed. As per the report, iron filings shall be absent. Hence it is alleged that the accused committed the offence. 3. Crl.M.C. No.2464/2018 is filed to quash the proceedings in S.T. No. 1534/2017 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court - III, Kottayam. In this case also, the prosecution is as per the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. In the aforesaid case, he is facing prosecution for having committed offences punishable under Section3.1 (zz) (iii) & (xi), 26 2(i), 27(i) and 59(i) of FSS Act, 2006 r/w. Regulation No. 2.10.1:(1) of Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standard and Food Additives) Regulations 2011.
texts.arguments: 3. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, through its Director (RCD) had issued Annexure- IV order dated 02.11.2017, whereby directions were issued to the States not to launch prosecution for non-conformance of the limit of iron filings for cases where samples were picked up/tested prior to 19.05.2016. Directions were Crl.M.C. Nos.6319 of 2017 & 2464 of 2018 2024:KER:65531 also issued to withdraw all such prosecutions launched prior to 19.05.2016, either under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 or under the PFA Act, 1954.

annotations_dropped.text_preview: The short point raised by the petitioners is that, in the light of the order dated 17.08.2023 in Crl.M.C. No.7955/2017, the prosecution against the petitioners is to be quashed.
I think there is force in the above contention.

The learned counsel submits that in identical circumstances, this Court had quashed the proceedings against the accused by order dated 05.02.2018 in Crl.
M.C.No.3248 of 2017.
The order dated 02.11.2017 is seen issued by the Director.

Paragraph No. 5 of the order reads as under:-
"The matter has been examined in FSSAI.
It is felt that till a reliable method of assessment/testing of iron filings in Tea is finalised.

It would not be appropriate to launch prosecution non- conformance nor is it proper to pursue or continue with the prosecutions launched under PFA Act/FSS Act prior to issue of FSSAI's Order dated 19.05.2016.

Commissioners of Food Safety, All states/UTs are, therefore, directed not to launch prosecutions for non-conformance of limit of iron filings for cases where samples were picked up/tested prior to 19.05.2016.

They are also advised to Muhammed Sabir vs Food Safety Officer on 23 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149350961/
4 withdraw all such prosecutions Crl.M.C. Nos.6319 of 2017 & 2464 of 2018 2024:KER:65531 launched prior
In the instant case, the sample was taken on 07.12.2015 and therefore, the petitioner is entitled to the benefits of the above order.
All further proceedings against the petitioner in S.T. No. 831/2016 Of Judicial Magistrate Of First Class -I, Idukki, are quashed."
6. From the above, it is clear that no prosecution can be initiated for cases where the samples were picked up/tested prior to 19.05.2016.
Admittedly, in these cases, the samples were picked up/tested prior to 19.05.2016.
If that be the case, the prosecution is unsustainable.

Therefore, these Criminal Miscellaneous Cases are allowed in the following manner:
1.

In Crl.M.C. No.2464/2018, all further proceedings against the petitioner in S.T.
No.1534/2017 on the file of the Judicial First Crl.M.C. Nos.6319 of 2017 & 2464 of 2018 2024:KER:65531 Class Magistrate Court - III, Kottayam are quashed.

2. In Crl.M.C. No.6319/2017, all further proceedings against the petitioner in S.T.
No.1030/2016 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court - II,
Kothamangalam are quashed.
